values.note: City of Littlefork: $30.90 a night for an electric and water site, plus $2.27 tax ($33.17); weekly $185.40 and monthly $437.75 before tax. Tent sites $15.45 a night.

fees.source: https://littleforkmn.gov/campground ('14 campsites with electric and water hookups / Overnite $30.90 + $2.27 TAX = $33.17 TOTAL / Weekly $185.40 + $13.68 TAX = $199.08 TOTAL / Monthly $437.75 + $32.29 TAX = $470.04 TOTAL'; 'Unlimited tenting sites Overnite $15.45 + $1.14 TAX'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: 14 RV sites (one RV and one extra tent each; site 9 accessible) in upper (1-8) and lower (9-15) sections, plus a primitive tent area.

sites.source: Campground Policy ('There are 14 RV sites. One RV is allowed per paid RV campsite and with one additional tent per site allowed. There is one primitive tent site for up to 4 tents or 12 people'; 'Site #9 is a designated accessible site'; 'One is in the upper section near sites 1-8 and one in the lower section near sites 9-15') + city page ('14 campsites with electric and water hookups'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://littleforkmn.gov/campground ('The campground has showers and restrooms available onsite.'; 'RV dumpsite available onsite ($10 fee for unregistered campers)'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Prepaid online reservations through Campspot; cancel 7 days ahead for a refund. Two-night minimum on Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends.

booking.source: Campground Policy ('Reservations may be made online at CAMPSPOT through the city website ... up to one year prior to arrival. The city requires reservations to be prepaid. A minimum stay of two nights is required over the following holidays: Memorial weekend, 4th of July and Labor Day weekends. Any cancellations must be made 7 days prior to arrival to receive a refund.') + city page ('RESERVE YOUR SITE ONLINE THROUGH CAMPSPOT HERE'), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Littlefork park at the end of Fourth Avenue, beside the Littlefork River, with a boat access, hiking and ski trail, tennis court and disc golf. The campsites sit in a small loop about 200 m from the river through woods. ATVs may drive to and from sites on the campground road. --Claude
